limitations: One corpus partitioned into twelve logical projects
Three body-length predicates plus an empty-output control
One Linux configuration and shared pinned CPU
No cache flushing or exclusive CPU ownership
Pipe wire bytes are not physical I/O or resident memory
Phase timings include instrumentation and do not isolate causal costs
Descriptive paired observations, not independent per-request trials or confidence intervals
